snippet.title: Official Announcement Trailer - Fantasy World Manager
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3447280?utm_source=trailer

Fantasy World Manager is the ultimate, gamified tool for creating, simulating, and observing living fantasy worlds. 

Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.
